# DigiCert

> DigiCert is a leading provider of digital trust solutions, specializing in TLS/SSL certificates, PKI, and IoT security.

## Overview

- [DigiCert Overview](https://www.digicert.com/): Offers scalable solutions for identity and encryption, recognized for its enterprise-grade certificate management platform and exceptional customer support.

## DigiCert One

- [DigiCert ONE](https://www.digicert.com/digicert-one): Platform overview for managing digital trust across certificates, devices, software, and documents.
- [Trust Lifecycle Manager](https://www.digicert.com/trust-lifecycle-manager): Centralized certificate lifecycle management.
- [CertCentral TLS/SSL Manager](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/certcentral-tls-ssl-manager): Automate and manage SSL certificates efficiently.
- [Software Trust Manager](https://www.digicert.com/software-trust-manager): Secure code signing solutions.
- [Device Trust Manager](https://www.digicert.com/device-trust-manager): IoT device identity and security.
- [Document Trust Manager](https://www.digicert.com/document-trust-manager): Secure document signing services.
- [DNS Solutions](https://www.digicert.com/dns-solutions): DNS security and authentication.
- [TrustCore SDK](https://www.digicert.com/iot/trustcore-sdk): SDK for IoT security.
- [Private/Internal PKI](https://www.digicert.com/private-pki): Simplify Private Trust.

## Key Solutions

## DDoS & WAF

- [DDoS Mitigation Service](https://vercara.digicert.com/ddos-protection): Cloud-based mitigation services for volumetric and application-layer DDoS attacks.
- [Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF)](https://vercara.digicert.com/ultrawaf): Web application firewall service for protecting applications and APIs.
- [Authoritative DNS](https://vercara.digicert.com/authoritative-dns): Managed authoritative DNS service focused on performance and availability.
- [DNS Cache Acceleration](https://vercara.digicert.com/dns-cache-acceleration): Improve DNS response performance and resilience with distributed caching.

## TLS-SSL Certificates

- [TLS/SSL Certificates](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/tls-ssl-certificates): Comprehensive overview of TLS/SSL certificates.
- [Basic TLS/SSL](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/basic-tls-ssl-certificates): Basic TLS/SSL certificates for small businesses.
- [Secure Site SSL](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/secure-site-ssl-certificates): Secure Site SSL solutions.
- [Secure Site Pro SSL](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/secure-site-pro-ssl): Secure Site Pro SSL with advanced features.
- [Wildcard SSL](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/wildcard-ssl-certificates): Secure multiple subdomains with one certificate.
- [Multi-Domain SSL](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/multi-domain-ssl-certificates): Secure multiple domains with a single SSL certificate.
- [EV SSL Certificates](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/ev-ssl-certificates): Extended validation certificates for high-assurance website identity and encryption.
- [OV SSL Certificates](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/ov-ssl-certificates): Organization-validated certificates for business identity and encrypted web traffic.
- [CertCentral](https://www.digicert.com/tls-ssl/certcentral): Platform for ordering, issuing, and managing digital certificates at scale.

- [SSL Certificate Checker](https://www.digicert.com/help/): Validate SSL certificates.
